newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish repo allocates six bln Skr to market.
newsitem.headline: Swedish repo allocates six bln Skr to market.

text.p: Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, said on Tuesday it allocated six billion crowns to the market in its weekly repurchase operation.
The one-week repo was set at an unchanged fixed rate of 4.10 percent and will run from June 18 to June 25.
The operation replaces an operation that allocated four billion crowns to the market.
The Riksbank said 11.88 percent of the bids for the tender were allocated.
